#include <iostream>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

long long oneRow(long long c) {
    long long m = c % 6;
    if (m == 0) return c;
    if (m <= 3) return c - m;
    if (m == 4) return c - 2;
    return c - 1;
}

long long twoRows(long long c) {
    if (c == 3 || c == 7) return 2LL * (c - 1);
    return 2LL * c;
}

long long solve(long long r, long long c) {
    if (r < 3 && c < 3) return 0LL;
    if (r == 1) return oneRow(c);
    if (r == 2) return twoRows(c);
    return (r * c) & ~1LL;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);
    long long R, C;
    cin >> R >> C;
    long long a = min(R, C);
    long long b = max(R, C);
    cout << solve(a, b) << endl;
    return 0;
}
